mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 4.5% signals labor market tightening that increases consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE falls below 4.5, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts above 1000 thousand units and federal funds rate below 0.5% indicate strong housing demand under accommodative policy, stimulating consumer spending and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1000 and FEDFUNDS is below 0.5, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong economic growth (GDPC1 annualized growth > 1.5%) accelerates corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 annualized growth exceeds 1.5, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production above 100 (INDPRO > 100) signals expanding manufacturing output and business investment, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is above 100, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation above 2.5% signals persistent inflation that triggers Federal Reserve tightening, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment growth above 100 thousand (PAYEMS > 100) and rising retail sales (RSAFS > 450) indicate robust labor market and consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 100 and RSAFS exceeds 450, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS rise > 0.5% in 3 months) increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises by more than 0.5% in 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
